\[
x^2+\frac{4}{x^2}-4=\left(x-\frac2x\right)^2
\]
so
\[
\left(x^2+\frac{4}{x^2}-4\right)^3=\left(x-\frac2x\right)^6.
\]

The general term is
\[
\binom{6}{k}x^{6-k}\left(-\frac2x\right)^k
=\binom{6}{k}(-2)^k x^{6-2k}.
\]

Constant term: \(6-2k=0 \Rightarrow k=3\):
\[
\binom{6}{3}(-2)^3=20(-8)=-160.
\]

There is no \(x^{-1}\) term, since \(6-2k=-1\) has no integer solution.

Thus the constant term of the product with \(x+3\) is
\[
3(-160)=-480.
\]
